cohort: 136 patients with antenatally diagnosed cases of vasa previa, identified via ultrasound and electronic medical record, between January 2011 and July 2018 in 5 US centers.
finding: Outcomes in antenatally diagnosed cases of vasa previa are excellent, and there is a higher chance of resolution when the condition is diagnosed before 24 weeks of gestation.
mod_finding: All subjects with unresolved vasa previa underwent cesarean delivery at a median estimated gestational age of 34 weeks.
